description: §19.16.3 rule 1 — a deferred body SHALL NOT contain `return` (a), `fail` (b), `?` propagation (c), or a `break` whose target loop lies outside the deferred body (d). Each fires E-DEFER-CONTROL-FLOW: four occurrences.
rationale: §19.16.3 rule 1: a deferred body runs while its block is already exiting, so it cannot redirect control; each of the four forms is E-DEFER-CONTROL-FLOW. S478 (bootstrap triage C12): `risky` now returns a value. It only failed, so `risky()?` used a call that returns nothing as a value — "a call of a function that returns nothing is not a value (§48 \"The return rule\", rule 3; E-TYPE-001 in a value position)" (§4.14) — which is a second, unrelated error at probe (c).
